referents.why: First person singular possessive 'my shepherd' in the psalm's own voice; the psalm quotes no one, so this is the voice candidate.
Implied first person singular subject of the yiqtol 'I shall not want'; the psalm's voice.

groups.why: The heading 'a psalm of David' is the frame and names David as writer; the two clauses are the psalm's text.

cant_tell.what: Whether 'I shall not want' (cl2) is a reason for or a result of 'The LORD is my shepherd' (cl1), or simply set beside it
cant_tell.why: The clauses are juxtaposed with a semicolon and no conjunction, no ki or other connective; so no because or result link is recorded.
